about: Files of old trillion (commit 5dc302be, Trillion-X/trillion main) whose job is this tool's, moved here byte for byte by the old-trillion sweep, under their old paths so they import each other as they did. Only import paths and the listed calls differ. A file that cannot load or pass here yet is held: its name ends in .held (the same bytes once its calls are swapped). Nothing here is wired into tool-rows.json: wiring a file is adapting it, in a commit that names this receipt.

calls.means: This repository is public and holds made-up data only: the first name of the real person a comment quotes (the word just before the quote's date) becomes a made-up one. The row matches the name by its place, so this receipt does not spell it either. Nothing else in the file changes.

files.adapted: the same bytes under another name: receipt trillion-workshop:tools/person-profile/moved-from.json
